name: hcapp_getRuns
description: Returns a user's run attendance history for a specific kennel — all past events where the user's HasherEventMap AttendenceState >= 20, IsCountedRun=1, IsVisible=1, ordered by start date descending.

parameters.name: kennelId
parameters.description: Kennel to filter runs by. Default null-UUID.

rowsets.name: RunHistory
rowsets.description: User's attended run history for the specified kennel. Empty when no qualifying runs found.

columns.name: eventStartDatetime
columns.description: Start time — UseFbRunDetails chooses between FbEventStartDatetime and EventStartDatetime. Forced to DATETIME2 (local time hack — no UTC offset sent).

columns.name: eventName
columns.description: UseFbRunDetails chooses between FbEventName and EventName.

columns.name: locationOneLineDesc
columns.description: Location with FB/non-FB fallback, defaulting to '<unknown location>'.

columns.name: totalRunsThisKennel
columns.description: HasherEventMap.TotalRunsThisKennel — running total at time of this run.

codeSmells.issue: Duplicate null-kennelId check — second check is dead code
codeSmells.detail: The SP checks @kennelId IS NULL twice. The second check (after auth validation) can never be reached because the first check triggers RETURN. The second block also uses a different errorType (3 vs 2) — inconsistency that will never matter because it's unreachable.
Local variable declared as @timeWindows (plural) instead of @timeWindow. Consistent with other SPs but still a typo that creates confusion.

codeSmells.issue: SET NOCOUNT ON placed after initial error checks
codeSmells.detail: SET NOCOUNT ON appears after the first IF blocks — this means the initial error rowsets could be affected by row count messages. Should be the first statement in BEGIN.

codeSmells.issue: eventStartDatetime forced to DATETIME2 losing timezone
codeSmells.detail: CONVERT(datetime2, e.EventStartDatetime) strips the timezone offset, sending local-time data as if it were UTC. Comment in SP acknowledges this as a TODO.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
